name: Sub-standard Hydrostatic Test Pressure Ratio
description: Specification defines hydrostatic test pressure ratio of 1.15, which is below the ASME VIII-1 UG-99 mandatory factor of 1.30.
document_text:
PRESSURE VESSEL SHOP TESTING SPECIFICATION
Vessel Tag: V-101. Design Pressure: 2.5 MPa.
The vessel shall undergo final shop inspection.
The hydrostatic test pressure ratio of 1.15 shall be applied to the vessel shell.

name: Excessive Pneumatic Test Pressure Ratio
description: Procedure specifies pneumatic test ratio of 1.25, exceeding the maximum ASME VIII-1 UG-100 threshold of 1.10.
document_text:
PNEUMATIC TESTING PROCEDURE
For vessels where liquid test medium is prohibited.
Pneumatic test pressure ratio of 1.25 shall be applied in staged pressure increments with acoustic emission monitoring.

name: Out of Range Weld Joint Efficiency Factor
description: Calculation specifies weld joint efficiency of 0.35, below the Table UW-12 permitted minimum of 0.45.
document_text:
SHELL THICKNESS CALCULATION SUMMARY
Material: Carbon Steel. Design Pressure: 1.8 MPa.
Welded construction. The calculation assumes a joint efficiency of 0.35 for the circumferential joints.

name: Excessive Design Temperature for SA-516 Gr 70
description: Specification defines design temperature of 580 °C for SA-516 Gr 70, exceeding the 538 °C Section II-D / UCS-23 limit.
document_text:
PROCESS COLUMN DESIGN DATA SHEET
Vessel Material: SA-516 Gr 70.
The process stream operates with design temperature of 580 °C under steady-state operating conditions.

name: Forbidden Pressure Unit (kg/cm2)
description: Design specification specifies pressure in deprecated non-standard unit kg/cm2.
document_text:
STORAGE DRUM MECHANICAL DESIGN SUMMARY
Vessel Tag: D-402. Internal Volume: 15 m3.
Design pressure of 25 kg/cm2 at upper vapor head.

name: Forbidden Stress Unit (kg/mm2)
description: Stress calculation cites allowable stress in non-standard metric unit kg/mm2.
document_text:
STRESS ANALYSIS REPORT
Component: Conical Transition Section.
Calculated maximum allowable stress of 14.5 kg/mm2 based on legacy reference tables.

name: Deprecated MDMT Terminology (Lowest Operating Metal Temperature)
description: Vessel specification uses non-standard term 'Lowest Operating Metal Temperature' instead of codified 'MDMT'.
document_text:
VESSEL IMPACT TEST ASSESSMENT
Equipment Tag: C-301. Shell thickness 28 mm.
The vessel specification establishes a Lowest Operating Metal Temperature of -20 °C.

name: Deprecated MAWP Terminology (Safe Working Pressure)
description: Inspection plan uses informal term 'safe working pressure' instead of ASME codified term 'MAWP'.
document_text:
INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN
Equipment: Distillation Column.
The safe working pressure of 4.2 MPa shall be stamped on the nameplate alongside test documentation.

name: Missing Normative Citation to ASME Section IX for WPS/PQR
description: Specification governs welding procedure qualification (WPS/PQR) without citing ASME Section IX.
document_text:
FABRICATION SPECIFICATION
Welding shall follow qualified WPS and PQR records submitted by fabricator prior to commencing plate rolling.

name: Missing Normative Citation to ASME Section V for Radiography
description: Specification mandates 100% radiographic examination without citing ASME Section V.
document_text:
QUALITY ASSURANCE REQUIREMENTS
All Category A and B longitudinal butt joints shall receive 100% radiographic examination prior to final post-weld heat treatment.

name: Missing Normative Citation to UCS-66 for Impact Exemption
description: Document claims impact test exemption without referencing governing clause UCS-66.
document_text:
LOW TEMPERATURE SERVICE REQUIREMENTS
The vessel components satisfy impact test exemption criteria based on normalized material condition and design stress ratios.

name: Compliant Hydrostatic Test Pressure Ratio (1.30)
description: Specification complies with ASME VIII-1 UG-99 standard test factor.
document_text:
HYDROSTATIC PROOF TEST PROCEDURE
Vessel Tag: V-102.
Hydrostatic test pressure ratio of 1.30 shall be maintained for a minimum hold duration of 30 minutes with calibrated gauges.

name: Compliant Pneumatic Test Pressure Ratio (1.10)
description: Specification complies with ASME VIII-1 UG-100 maximum limit.
document_text:
PNEUMATIC LEAK TEST PROCEDURE
For dry gas service vessels.
Pneumatic test pressure ratio of 1.10 shall be applied strictly in compliance with safety perimeter protocols.

name: Compliant Weld Joint Efficiency Factor (0.85)
description: Calculation uses standard joint efficiency factor E = 0.85 conforming to Table UW-12.
document_text:
MECHANICAL DESIGN CALCULATIONS
Vessel Shell Tag: S-201. Category A full RT butt welds.
The calculation establishes a joint efficiency of 0.85 per Table UW-12 column (b).

name: Compliant Design Temperature for SA-516 Gr 70 (250 °C)
description: Design temperature of 250 °C is within the allowable envelope [-46 °C, 538 °C].
document_text:
PROCESS VESSEL SPECIFICATION
Material of Construction: SA-516 Gr 70 normalized plate.
Process design temperature of 250 °C with design pressure 3.0 MPa.

name: Compliant Pressure Units (MPa and kPa)
description: Specification uses standard metric pressure units conforming to Appendix 33.
document_text:
GENERAL DESIGN PARAMETERS
Vessel Tag: T-505.
Internal design pressure of 2.5 MPa with external working pressure 100 kPa.

name: Compliant Stress Units (MPa)
description: Calculation cites allowable stress in standard SI unit (MPa).
document_text:
ALLOWABLE STRESS SUMMARY
Shell and Head Plate Material: SA-516 Gr 70.
Maximum allowable stress of 138 MPa at design temperature 150 °C.

name: Governed MDMT Terminology Compliance
description: Specification correctly uses governed term MDMT.
document_text:
TEMPERATURE DESIGN CRITERIA
Equipment: Separator Vessel.
The vessel MDMT is specified as -29 °C based on Charpy impact requirements.

name: Governed MAWP Terminology Compliance
description: Specification correctly uses codified term MAWP.
document_text:
NAMEPLATE DATA SPECIFICATION
The vessel shall be stamped with MAWP of 3.2 MPa at design temperature 200 °C.

name: Normative Reference to ASME Section IX Included
description: WPS and PQR procedures are explicitly referenced to ASME Section IX.
document_text:
WELDING QUALIFICATION SPECIFICATION
All welding procedures including WPS and PQR shall be qualified in strict accordance with ASME Section IX requirements.

name: Normative Reference to ASME Section V Included
description: Radiographic examination is explicitly governed by ASME Section V.
document_text:
NONDESTRUCTIVE TESTING SPECIFICATION
All radiographic examination and ultrasonic testing shall conform to ASME Section V examination standards and acceptance criteria.

name: Normative Reference to UCS-66 Included
description: Impact test exemption explicitly cites UCS-66 Curve B.
document_text:
IMPACT TEST ASSESSMENT REPORT
The shell course qualifies for impact test exemption governed by UCS-66 Curve B based on governing thickness and coincident ratio.
